'''The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and [[Casino/Legends|Casino]]''' was a gambling stablishment operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It was owned by [[Nyubuna Bulul]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].

This locale was in front of [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]], which was its direct competitor as both of them offered services. The Even Cut specialized in gambling and offered a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] table at any moment.
